pattern: moving a note into a folder is a transform, not a delete and a write
experience: Asked to file a note under a folder, an agent told wikis have no folders either refuses or writes the note anew and deletes the old one, and every link to it goes red.
rule: astrolabe_wiki_transform: rename or move a note, canvas or folder with kind "rename".
